contents.text: Devin has a kitten called Whiskers and a cat called Felix. Each day, Whiskers eats 1 can of food, and Felix eats 2 cans of food. Devin is going on a trip for 14 days and needs to leave cat food with the pet sitter. How many cans of food does Devin need to leave?

content.text: Step 1: Find how many cans of food the cats eat each day.

contents.text: Each day, Whiskers eats 1 can of food, and Felix eats 2 cans of food. Add.
Each day, they eat 3 cans of food in total.

content.text: Step 2: Find how many cans of food Devin needs to leave.

Brenna is starting a vegetable garden. So far, she has planted 1 row of tomato plants and 3 rows of squash plants. If she put 11 plants in each row, how many plants are in the garden so far?

contents.text: Brenna has planted 1 row of tomato plants and 3 rows of squash plants. Add.
Brenna has planted 4 rows of plants.

content.text: Step 2: Find the total number of plants.

contents.text: Brenna put 11 plants in each row. Multiply.
There are 44 plants in the garden so far.
